stage0082_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$冬月$$
（The messenger...
　So, she's appeared after all...）

stage0082_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
（That is how it is）

stage0082_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ニア$$
「Earth's humanity, attempting to trespass
　into the forbidden domain...」

stage0082_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マヤ$$
「All communication devices have been hijacked!」

stage0082_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ニア$$
「You do not deserve the mercy of the Prison of Time」

stage0082_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ニア$$
「I am a messenger, come to tell you of despair...
　The $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ declares annihilation
　upon Earth's humanity once more」

stage0082_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シゲル$$
「So $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ is the mysterious
　cosmic life form that appeared before
　the $$新世時空震動$$...!」

stage0082_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ボビー$$
「So this is the Geofront, beneath
　$$第３新東京市$$...」

stage0082_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$キャシー$$
「$$アドヴェント$$ had the entry code to this place,
　a fortress built to prevent Third Impact...」

stage0082_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The power of Chrono... formidable indeed」

stage0082_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$シモン$$!
　Look at that!」

stage0082_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$シモン$$
「Why!?
　Why are you the messenger again!?」

stage0082_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ニア$$
「I was, from the very start, born as
　a terminal of the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　A virtual life form, so to speak...」

stage0082_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ニア$$
「I'm only someone who woke from
　sleep, now that the time has come」

stage0082_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$キタン$$
「You saying that's your real form!?」

stage0082_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If you've taken that form, then...」

stage0082_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ニア$$
「Then, $$シモン$$...
　I shall tell you of despair once again」

stage0082_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ニア$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ will
　annihilate Earth's humanity,
　even should the Prison of Time be completed」

stage0082_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$キタン$$
「So you've shown up, you faceless bastard!」

stage0082_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Watch out!
　Something else is coming!」

stage0082_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
「$$ジェミニア$$!
　Did $$ガドライト$$ come!?」

stage0082_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, the Imitation Boy and the pest
　show up. Guess all the players are here」

stage0082_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ニア$$
「A Geminaid...
　So this is where you were」

stage0082_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...anyway, our goals may differ,
　but what you and I are trying to do
　is the same. I'll lend you a hand」

stage0082_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ニア$$
「Anger, and resignation...
　So that is the source of your power」

stage0082_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ニア$$
「...Very well.
　I'll leave this to you」

stage0082_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Whoa...!
　Sorry, but you're stuck with me today」

stage0082_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$n
「You...!
　Just how long do you plan to play around!」

stage0082_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Then I guess I'll get a little serious」

stage0082_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Bad luck, you lot.
　That messenger girl got me
　a little riled up...」

stage0082_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So, just like you wanted,
　I'll fight you a little bit for real」

stage0082_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't let him overwhelm you, $n...!」

stage0082_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Truth is, I only came this time to
　watch the Anti-Spirals. So I'll only
　give you three minutes of my time」

stage0082_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Though in those three minutes,
　I could wipe you all out just as easily」

stage0082_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$葵$$
「Keep underestimating people like that,
　and you'll get more than hurt...!」

stage0082_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahaha, that's a good one!
　No power, but a real talent for comedy!」

stage0082_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Come on then.
　I'll teach you what despair means」

stage0082_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ミサト$$...!
　Unit-01 is under maintenance at NERV HQ!
　I'll sortie too!」

stage0082_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Wait, $$シンジ$$.
　Until Commander Ikari issues a sortie order,
　I can't let you take out an EVA!」

stage0082_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But $$赤木$$ and the others, and
　Ayanami and $$アスカ$$ too, are fighting...!」

stage0082_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Let's trust everyone for now.
　That's the only thing we can do」

stage0082_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト$$!
　I'll settle this here and now!」

stage0082_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Guess I got underestimated too」

stage0082_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「My promised three minutes are up.
　I'll be heading home now」

stage0082_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$n
「Like I'll let you go!
　I'll settle this here, $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0082_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Guess I got underestimated too」

stage0082_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Time to say goodbye, Imitation Boy!」

stage0082_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You and that machine of yours are an eyesore!」

stage0082_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You just won't stop getting in my way!」

stage0082_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You couldn't possibly understand...!
　The power hidden within him... the hope!」

stage0082_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Well, that killed the mood.
　I'll leave the rest to you...」

stage0082_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Focus on $$アドヴェント$$ right now...!」

stage0082_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$n
「...Sorry, $$アドヴェント$$.
　For covering for me」

stage0082_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't worry about it, $n.
　Helping you is a joy of mine as well」

stage0082_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But I've taken too much damage, even for me.
　I'll be falling back here」

stage0082_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'm counting on you, $c.
　You're the ones who'll protect this planet」

stage0082_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But it seems we couldn't ask about Chrono after all」

stage0082_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「This isn't the time for that!
　Thanks to dealing with $$ガドライト$$,
　we're totally wrecked over here!」

stage0082_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$正太郎$$
「And with $$アドヴェント$$ pulling out,
　our fighting strength has dropped too!」

stage0082_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't you dare start whining!
　Lose heart, and that's where it all falls apart!」

stage0082_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$n
「He stopped the attack with an A.T. Field...!」

stage0082_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$マコト$$
「Did it climb the elevator under its own power!?」

stage0082_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I don't recall ordering a sortie」

stage0082_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Do you think that's something
　that would be allowed?」

stage0082_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Just because you're my father doesn't
　mean you can stop me!」

stage0082_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$ pilot,
　$$碇シンジ$$!」

stage0082_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'm counting on you, $$シンジ$$!」

stage0082_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You're late, you idiot $$シンジ$$!
　What were you doing all this time!」

stage0082_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry...!
　But I'll make up for it!」

stage0082_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$葵$$
「Might be worth watching him, down the line.」

stage0082_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$桂$$
「Yeah.
　His growth rate from here's gonna be crazy, I bet.」

stage0082_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シモン$$
「See that, $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...!
　We're... humanity's growing stronger every day!」

stage0082_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$シモン$$
「If that's something you won't allow,
　then we'll resist with everything we've got!
　That's our fight... that's what it means to live!!」

stage0082_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$不動$$
「No... this is where it begins.」

stage0082_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$キタン$$
「Both $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ and Geminis
　can go jump in a lake, for all I care!」

stage0082_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「There's no time to grieve.
　Not for you, not for this planet.」

stage0082_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The battle at Dakar is over, too...
　And I hear Lady $$ニア$$ appeared over there
　as well, delivering a declaration of war.」

stage0082_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So unlike last time, they didn't send
　a message out to the whole world this time?」

stage0082_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Their target is $$シモン$$... and us, then?」

stage0082_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Guess losing to us really pissed 'em off.」

stage0082_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$甲児$$
「If that's how they wanna play it,
　we'll settle this once and for all this time...!」

stage0082_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$ are back
　with the unit. I hear the detached force
　is heading to Japan too, to plan ahead.」

stage0082_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$葵$$
「As $$エタニティ・フラット$$'s completion nears,
　things are getting noisy everywhere, huh.」

stage0082_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$タケル$$
「Every organization's bound to make its move.」

stage0082_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アルト$$
「The time for the final battle is near...」

stage0082_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I'm going to step out for a bit.」

stage0082_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「You'll come back, right, $$シンジ$$?」

stage0082_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is where you belong, you know.」

stage0082_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アスカ$$
「We cooked last time,
　so it's your turn now, got it?」

stage0082_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$マリ$$
「Ugh, and here I finally made it to Japan,
　but there's no room for me to squeeze in...」

stage0082_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$マリ$$
「Ah well... guess that's fine.
　Do your best, all you EVA folks.」

stage0082_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Coming at me in an imitation chrysalis, huh...
　Kids sure don't know fear, do they.」

stage0082_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$n
「Shut up, $$ガドライト$$!
　It's time you paid for all the lives you've
　taken so far, treating it all like a game!」

stage0082_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$n
「And for taking my father's and sister's lives,
　I'll make you regret it in hell!」

stage0082_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Finally came out, did you, imitation!
　I'll show you the power of the real thing!」

stage0082_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「Real or fake, it doesn't matter to me!
　I'll beat you with this $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, that's it!!」

stage0082_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's what they call not knowing your place, kid!
　I'll show you the real bickering twins' power!!」

stage0082_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You keep buzzing around getting in our way...!」

stage0082_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Watching over humanity's evolution is Chrono's
　true purpose. I won't tolerate anything
　that would distort it!」

stage0082_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's go, Geminis!
　Don't go thinking you're the only one
　who can wield the power of the $$スフィア$$!!」

stage0082_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$シモン$$
（Wait for me, $$ニア$$!
　I'll definitely come get you!）

stage0082_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$シモン$$
「Come on then, $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$!
　I'll fight you to the very end,
　until you can't touch Earth or $$ニア$$ again!!」

stage0082_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$キタン$$
「You faceless bastards!
　Thought I'd never see your ugly mugs again,
　but you just don't learn, do ya!」

stage0082_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$キタン$$
「Then I'll teach you a lesson to the bone!
　Earth's got the Dai-Gurren Brigade and $c,
　and this $$キタン$$, you hear!!」

stage0082_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「I can't forgive this...
　The nerve, to talk about wiping out people
　who are doing their best to live...!」

stage0082_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Most of all, dragging $$ニア$$ into this again,
　right when she was at the height of happiness,
　about to marry $$シモン$$!」

stage0082_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Let's do this, $$ダリー$$!
　We won't let $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ have its way!」

stage0082_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ダリー$$
「I know!
　For $$シモン$$'s sake too, we have to
　get $$ニア$$ back, no matter what!」

stage0082_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's not for my father's sake...
　I pilot EVA for myself,
　and for the people precious to me...!」

stage0082_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm not... my father's puppet!
　I'm $c's $$碇シンジ$$!!」

stage0082_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「$$ミサト$$ and stupid $$シンジ$$, what are you both
　doing at a time like this!」

stage0082_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Get out here already, stupid $$シンジ$$!
　Your job's to fight in EVA too, you know!」
